user_stories.title: Generate PDF from a JSON source
user_stories.description:
As a documentation maintainer
I can render a PDF from a canonical JSON file
so that I can publish living documentation.
business_value: Removes manual document assembly using **markdown** formatting.
Keeps published docs in sync with the source of truth.
preconditions: A canonical JSON source file exists.
A document type or custom template set is selected.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a valid source file, when the action runs, then a PDF is produced.
Given **markdown** content, then it is rendered as formatted HTML in the PDF.

user_stories.title: Validate the source against a schema
user_stories.description:
As a producer
I can validate my JSON against a schema
so that I catch contract drift early.
preconditions: A JSON Schema file is available.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a schema path, when validation fails, then the run stops with a clear error.

user_stories.title: Override the built-in template
user_stories.description:
As a maintainer
I can provide my own templates
so that the output matches my brand.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a template-path, when rendering, then the custom main template is used.
